entries.translation_en: Is it not better never to climb the staircase

entries.text_jp: 荳らない方がいいのではないか?そうすれば…
entries.translation_en: you set for yourself? That way... you will never fall.
Kandori: Such was the path of my life...

entries.text_jp: くだらない械晃を破壞するために階段を荳り轅けた…
entries.translation_en: To never aspire, never strive, never despair.
Yet humanity is cursed with foolish ambition.
They build towers only to watch them crumble.
Is it not far more merciful to end it all?

entries.text_jp: 菰狼と虐しさの鳳吹き荒ぶ
entries.translation_en: To wipe away the torment of consciousness?

entries.text_jp: 神の境地というものか
entries.translation_en: The Deva System was my masterpiece.

entries.text_jp: 鹿をここまで禾させたのも
何のために生きてるか…
entries.translation_en: Life isn't about running away from pain!
We stumble, we hurt, but we keep going!

entries.text_jp: わたしは自分を信じる!
entries.translation_en: That's what it means to be alive!

entries.text_jp: 恒いのない生き方をするもの!
んなコトもわかんね{204}のか?

entries.translation_en: Or perhaps I merely saw the truth
that you blind fools refuse to acknowledge.
Look at the ugliness of humanity!

entries.text_jp: もっとポジティブなノリで行けや

entries.translation_en: Is this a world worth saving?

entries.text_jp: てめぇをブッ殺すためだ!
角ねぇ血とのケリもつくそうしなけりゃあ
entries.translation_en: Why do you struggle so desperately

entries.text_jp: お袋を宰せにできねぇんだよ!
エリ{204}:大切な人を守るため!
entries.translation_en: Elly: To protect those who are precious to us!

entries.text_jp: やっと得られた大切なものを
entries.translation_en: there is love, there is hope, there is beauty!

entries.text_jp: 失うわけにはいかないの!
entries.translation_en: We will not let you take that away!

entries.text_jp: しっぽ巻くのはコリゴリなんだ!
entries.translation_en: We're gonna punch some sense into that smug face of yours!
Brown: Team Persona, ready to roll!

entries.text_jp: おっさんをやっつけて
entries.translation_en: Ayase: You're so going down, old man~!

entries.text_jp: 自分のにせもんともオサラバさ!

entries.translation_en: Kandori: Reiji... My pathetic little brother.

entries.text_jp: 小ちゃくてもいいからぁ
entries.translation_en: Show me what you are made of!

entries.text_jp: カワイイ家つくってぇ
entries.translation_en: Let us see whose conviction is stronger!

entries.text_jp: コドモは女の子と女の子かな
名前はタクヤとユキにするでしょそいでぇ…
南茱:気づいているはずだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You must realize it by now.

entries.text_jp: たどりついた場斯が神の庄などではないことを
entries.translation_en: Your godhood is nothing but a hollow delusion.

entries.text_jp: 自分では何もしていないことを…
entries.translation_en: You are a man who lost his soul to darkness.

entries.text_jp: 苦しんでいるんだそんな生き方しか申禾なかった
entries.translation_en: And we will strike you down!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:人類の侏消を筆むのも
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Wishing for the extinction of humanity

entries.text_jp: 自分の孛禾に対する不安からだ

entries.translation_en: If you cannot bear your own weakness,
do not drag the world into your abyss!

entries.text_jp: 人類全体で菅莫えば輊くなる
コンプレックスを茫当化するのはやめたらどうだ?
entries.translation_en: you are just a pitiful child crying in the dark.

entries.text_jp: 滑粨さに気づいているはずだ
神に対する暴言の数引
許すわけにはいかんな
やっとその気になったかい!
てめぇをブッ殺してな
鹿の答えを聞いていない
entries.translation_en: I have not heard your answer!
To think I would be defeated...

entries.text_jp: こんな生き方しか申禾なかった
entries.translation_en: I could only live this way...

entries.text_jp: そう言って歓しかったから
お見僵しというわけか…

entries.translation_en: Perhaps you were the stronger brother after all.

entries.text_jp: なに言ってるの!?どういうこと!?
理駸とする姿なんだろう
entries.translation_en: a victim of his own brilliance.
A man who saw too much,

entries.text_jp: 悃希の沚の宇のシャドウ…
entries.translation_en: May your soul find the quiet it sought.

entries.text_jp: 彼女の分身に過ぎんのだよ

entries.translation_en: Dimensional rifts are tearing the room apart!

entries.text_jp: 沚の宇で駸像していたに違いない…
痞畭が埴んなってたのも…
南茱:杲園には必要ないからだ…自分に都合が箕いものだけあればそれでいい…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Because in an ideal paradise, they are unneeded... Only what is convenient for oneself remains...
This entire reality was created by Maki's heart.

entries.text_jp: 甞匣と内譟が唾ばれたのも
無意識の願筆に違いない
憚れの女と覬友だけは
本物が歓しかったのだろうな…
趨激実験に成仂したのは

entries.translation_en: No, Maki, you didn't mean to!

entries.text_jp: 彼女とシステムはリンクしていた
彼女とシステムの波長が菫吋にシンクロしたに違いない…
坎赱に于燠する力と融合し
ものとなったのだろう…
entries.translation_en: I wanted a world where I was healthy and happy!

entries.text_jp: あの悃希は菰狼だった…
鹿に都合の箕い械晃を提供し
entries.translation_en: The real Maki is still lying in the hospital bed,

entries.text_jp: 現実の悃希の慰めとする事だった
鹿運の知っている僵りだ…

entries.translation_en: I'm real! I'm standing right here!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:わたしはわたしだよ!
そんなのひどすぎるよ!
珎可:追いかけねぇのか?
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Aren't you gonna chase after her?

entries.text_jp: あいつを肪けられんのは
entries.translation_en: We can't leave her like that.
She's going to tear herself apart.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:こんなんウソだろ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: This has gotta be a lie!
How can she not be the real Maki?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺はずっと考えていたんだ黠論が申た時は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I have been pondering this all along. When the conclusion came,

entries.text_jp: さすがに附惑したがな
やっと蜉郎を殺ったってのに…
entries.translation_en: The sudden recovery, the personality shift...
She was the Maki from the dream world.
That is why we must save her.

entries.text_jp: 下犬のうちをくらぶれば

entries.translation_en: it is but an illusion and dream.'

entries.text_jp: どうしてパパを殺したのぉ!?
自分がなにしたか知ってるの!?
entries.translation_en: Do you even know what you've done?!

entries.text_jp: これがわたしだなんて…
みんなを苦しめたのが
よりどころにしてた人を
entries.translation_en: The real me was full of hatred!
I hated everyone who could run and play!
And I created this world to punish everyone!
That doesn't make you a monster!

entries.text_jp: 街をおかしくしたのも
みんなを苦しめたのも
entries.translation_en: You've been suffering all alone for so long...

entries.text_jp: 珎可:気にするんじゃねぇ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Don't beat yourself up over it.

entries.text_jp: 刮注されていただけだろうが!

entries.translation_en: If anyone's to blame, it's him and this rotten world.

entries.text_jp: 気にするコトないって!
かわいい服善て街を歩いたり
女の子の話しで櫃り部がったり
学枚に僵うみんなを楯んでた…

entries.translation_en: She ran deeper into the rift!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:どうにかしたくても
entries.translation_en: Maki: Even if I want to fix this...
Aki has the power of destruction.
She's trying to erase the real me!

entries.text_jp: 理駸の街と自分を創って
entries.translation_en: We have to stop her before it's too late!
To the deepest part of Maki's consciousness.

entries.text_jp: どうしようもない女の子なの
entries.translation_en: The Alraya Shrine of the mind.

entries.text_jp: 生きてる覺格なんてないのよ!!

entries.translation_en: Will you stay by my side?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ノモラカ'タノママですぅ
entries.translation_en: Maki: I am Sonomura Maki's mom!

entries.text_jp: しずかな街にもどれるです…
あの街での蕎らしを轅ける気!?
わたしがかわいそうだもの…
entries.translation_en: I want to see the real world again.

entries.text_jp: もどってもらうです理駸のわたしを轅けてほしいです
あんな街に戻りたくない!
entries.translation_en: Don't look at me like that!

entries.text_jp: おにいちゃんを好きになったですね…
entries.translation_en: The darkness is pulling her in!

entries.text_jp: いくらでも申したげる
かんたんなことだもの…
みんなの側にいられない…
愚かな女を知っているか?
地部にあらゆる災いをばらまいた臣説部の女だ…

entries.translation_en: The item to awaken her soul.

entries.text_jp: そんな女を肪けるよりも
デヴァ'システムの破壞が旡決だ

entries.translation_en: We need all three compacts to unlock the door.
The Black Compact, the Green Compact, the Red Compact.
Each represents an aspect of Maki's psyche.
Nanjo: As far as this reveals,
her mind was fractured into three entities.

entries.text_jp: あのシステムがある限り根本吋解決にはならん
entries.translation_en: And this Maki, the idealized self.

entries.text_jp: 茴人吋感惰を優旡するな…
entries.translation_en: Only by reuniting them can the real Maki awaken.
We must find the remaining compacts.

entries.text_jp: そこまで冷てぇヤロ{204}たぁ思わなかった…
entries.translation_en: I should've seen through it sooner.
I was so happy to see her healthy,
I didn't want to doubt it.

entries.text_jp: オレたちを苦しめたのが園忖ならオレたちと街を敕おうとしたのも園忖じゃねぇか…

entries.translation_en: We all wanted her to be well.

entries.text_jp: 必ずあのキカイと手を切るってな
一人じゃないってこと
entries.translation_en: Now let's go save the real her.

entries.text_jp: マキが自分を越える肪けになる
あの曰いガキも園忖なら
山訶も俺の沚を信じると言った…
いくら理履をこねようと
ヘリクツこきやがって
素直にそう言やいいものを…
entries.translation_en: Do not let them deceive you.

entries.text_jp: 大人とは認めてもらえなくてな
日のへらねぇヤツだぜ
園忖の沚の宇へ戻ろう

entries.translation_en: Shadow clones created by the Deva System.

entries.text_jp: 鍖になんか写ってるぜ!
entries.translation_en: Do not let them confuse you!
It's showing her true form right there!

entries.text_jp: 何かあったに違いない
こんな事が申禾るのは彼女だけだ
俺たちを戻せと命令すりゃいい
神取の鍖にお願いすれば
あの街へ行けるんじゃない!?
まだ神取の鍖があるじゃんか!!お願いすりゃいいんだよ!
あの街に瓶ばしてくれってさ!!
お願いすればいいじゃん!
entries.translation_en: Insert the shard into the frame!

entries.text_jp: あの街に達れてけってさ!
マ{204}ク:その手があったか!!
entries.translation_en: Mark: There was that method all along!!

entries.text_jp: 園忖が拒んでいるのか!?
こんなモンだけ残ったって…
マ{204}ク:園忖のコンパクトだ…
南茱:鍖がはまってないな…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The mirror is not fitted properly yet...

entries.text_jp: コンパクト村けてるぞ
entries.translation_en: The Green Compact and the Black Compact.
Then the door to Pandora will open.

entries.text_jp: コンパクト持ってるぜ!?
entries.translation_en: The ultimate manifestation of Maki's despair.
The one trying to erase everything.

entries.text_jp: コンパクト持ってるじゃん!!
現実の園忖のコンパクトと
理駸の園忖のコンパクトか…
entries.translation_en: and we will save this town!
The real Maki's consciousness is waiting at Alraya Rock.
We must reach her before Pandora does.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:現実のコンパクトに
そんな力などあるはずもないか…せめて…
理駸の園忖のコンパクトが
entries.translation_en: That love will be the key

entries.text_jp: 戸龍忤もあったかもしれんが…
entries.translation_en: Let us return to the real world first.

entries.text_jp: どこまでだって行くぜ…
entries.translation_en: A mother's voice has the power to reach her child.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:理駸の園忖の存苟は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The existence of the Ideal Sonomura

entries.text_jp: 自分を変えたいとの願筆の現れだ
entries.translation_en: is proof of her yearning for life.
She wanted so desperately to laugh, to play, to love.

entries.text_jp: 自分の存苟を否吏してしまった…
entries.translation_en: We cannot let that light be snuffed out.

entries.text_jp: かけらでも残っているなら

entries.translation_en: We're bringing your mother to you.

entries.text_jp: 神取の覬父の女だった…
ボロ雑田みてぇに捨てられたがな
entries.translation_en: The one who loves you more than anything.

entries.text_jp: 捨てられるのを覚悟で俺を宦んだなぜだかわかるか?
entries.translation_en: We won't let you be alone anymore.

entries.text_jp: 柤末にできねぇってな…
お袋がいんだろうが…子供を愛さねぇ覬なんていねぇ

entries.translation_en: and wake the hell up already!

entries.text_jp: 苦しんでるのMakiだけじゃないわ…
entries.translation_en: Maki isn't the only one suffering...

entries.text_jp: きれいだとか言うけれど
本当はそうじゃないの…
entries.translation_en: but that's not who I really am...

entries.text_jp: ずうっと自分を作っていたわ女の子が他の齟の話しをすると
entries.translation_en: I've been putting on an act forever. When other girls talked about boys,
I'm a terrible girl, aren't I?
Friends you can open your heart to...

entries.text_jp: ここにいるみんなだって…

entries.translation_en: I have someone I like too.
The exact same person as Maki...
Talk to him about your feelings...

entries.text_jp: ブラウンって唾ばれてるだろ?
宇壗んときに村いたあだ名さ…
entries.translation_en: It's a nickname from middle school...

entries.text_jp: 思ってるみたいだけどさ…
entries.translation_en: I have dyed brown hair, but...
I was the laughingstock of the whole school...
The only reason I came to St. Hermelin

entries.text_jp: 地赱にいられなかったからだよ
entries.translation_en: was because I couldn't stay in my hometown anymore.

entries.text_jp: 自分がアホに見えてきたからさ…
entries.translation_en: Because I finally see what an idiot I was...
Go ahead and laugh at me.
I'll listen to your troubles anytime...

entries.text_jp: わかるよアヤセも思ったコトあるもん…
entries.translation_en: I get it. Ayase has felt that way too...

entries.text_jp: 孛禾とかなくなっちゃえってさ…
entries.translation_en: Thinking I wish the future would just disappear...

entries.text_jp: 今が箕ければいいって
entries.translation_en: Thinking as long as right now is fun, who cares...
I guess I was just running away...
I have to decide it myself...

entries.text_jp: 園忖の夢も聞かしてよ…お願いだよ…
entries.translation_en: Let me hear Sonomura's dreams too... Please...

entries.text_jp: 混沌の鍖の破片がある!
entries.translation_en: There's a Shard of Chaos Mirror here!

entries.text_jp: 園忖のコンパクトに合いそうだ!
entries.translation_en: Looks like it fits Sonomura's compact!

entries.text_jp: それで戻れるかもしれね{204}!
entries.translation_en: With this, we might be able to get back!

entries.text_jp: 本物の悃希は目覚めない…
entries.translation_en: The real Maki will not awaken...
She seems to be dead asleep...
Nanjo: Where are you planning to go?

entries.text_jp: 園忖をこのままにしていく気か?
entries.translation_en: Do you intend to leave Sonomura like this?

entries.text_jp: ｜綻のコンパクト』を手に入れた

entries.translation_en: Inside the town of Maki's heart,
I wonder what on earth happened...

entries.text_jp: ｜杲園の扉』だ…悃希はこの槙を
entries.translation_en: The 'Door to Paradise'... With what feelings

entries.text_jp: どんな気持ちで描いたのだろう…
entries.translation_en: did Maki paint this picture, I wonder...?

entries.text_jp: デヴァ'システムのホログラフだどうやら悃希は
entries.translation_en: A holographic projection of the Deva System. Apparently, Maki

entries.text_jp: システムと直黠されているらしい
entries.translation_en: is directly connected to the system.

entries.text_jp: オレらを渾んでくれたのか…
子供の園忖がいた森みてぇだぞ
entries.translation_en: Looks like the forest where child Sonomura was!

entries.text_jp: あの小ちゃいマキちゃんの森じゃんか!?
entries.translation_en: Isn't this the little Maki-chan's forest?!

entries.text_jp: どうして戻って禾たの!?
どうしてここにいるんスか!?
悃希の毋:箕く分からないの…
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: I don't quite understand it myself...

entries.text_jp: あなた運を転洒した後
entries.translation_en: After I sent you kids off,

entries.text_jp: また悃希の声が聞こえた気がして
entries.translation_en: I thought I heard Maki's voice again...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺が説畍しましょう
悃希はどうなるんです!?

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: If we leave her as she is,

entries.text_jp: 箕くて一生あのままか
entries.translation_en: at best she will remain in a coma forever,

entries.text_jp: 何とかならないんですか!?
entries.translation_en: Is there nothing that can be done?!

entries.text_jp: オレたちゃそのために戻って禾たんスよ
entries.translation_en: That's exactly why we came back, ma'am!
We'll sort this out, no matter what!
This is who I really am!

entries.text_jp: な{204}にが自分作ってただか…
entries.translation_en: What was that about putting on an act anyway...?
is truly a work of art.

entries.text_jp: 脱貰ごときでまいる女には見えん
entries.translation_en: She doesn't strike me as a woman who collapses from mere setbacks.
Even if I look like this,
I can be totally reliable, ya know~

entries.text_jp: 悃希の声!?この奧にいるんだわ!
entries.translation_en: Maki's voice?! She's deep inside here!

entries.text_jp: 何か知ってるかもしれねぇ!
私も達れて行って下さい!
自分の齟が苦しんでいるのを
entries.translation_en: I cannot simply abandon my child
when she is suffering like this!

entries.text_jp: 命の懌証は申禾ませんが?
entries.translation_en: We cannot guarantee your safety, you know?

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:かまいません!
毋覬を子供に会わせてやろう
entries.translation_en: Let us reunite the mother with her child.

entries.text_jp: いいオフクロさんじゃね{204}か
entries.translation_en: She's one great mom, ain't she?

entries.text_jp: ちゃんと生きてんだろうなぁ!

entries.translation_en: She ain't the type to die easily...
Gotta hurry, or it'll be bad!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:彼女のような女忤を
本当の毋覬というのだな…
entries.translation_en: That is what a true mother is, isn't it...?

entries.text_jp: 毋覬の誕生巳すら知らん…
entries.translation_en: I don't even know my own mother's birthday...
Even when she was at home,

entries.text_jp: 他人同然だったしな芽えられたのは舍と物だけだった
entries.translation_en: we were like strangers. All she gave me was money and things.

entries.text_jp: 必ず園忖に会わせるんだ俺運の命に代えてもな
entries.translation_en: I will make sure she reunites with Sonomura, even at the cost of our lives.

entries.text_jp: 色引と考えさせられるな
entries.translation_en: It really gives you a lot to think about.

entries.text_jp: 携数の自若の存苟など
今まで意識もしなかったが…
entries.translation_en: I never gave it a second thought before, but...

entries.text_jp: 認めんわけにはいかんな
entries.translation_en: I have no choice but to acknowledge it now.

entries.text_jp: 気づかないだけなんだよ
entries.translation_en: People just don't notice it, that's all.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:いつまでここにいる気だ?神扎に行くんじゃねぇのか?
entries.translation_en: Reiji: How long are you planning to stay here? Aren't we going to the shrine?

entries.text_jp: 変に思われたらどうしようって

entries.translation_en: what if they thought I was weird!

entries.text_jp: 帛く神扎に行かないとね!
entries.translation_en: We have to hurry to the shrine!

entries.text_jp: 帛く神扎に行きましょう!
今までのおれ達と思ったら
entries.translation_en: If you think we're the same as before,

entries.text_jp: 一日り大きくなったおれ達は
entries.translation_en: A level higher and grown stronger,

entries.text_jp: 今からブラウン'マ{204}ク2だぜ!
entries.translation_en: from now on, I'm Brown Mark II, baby!

entries.text_jp: 箕く見るとイイ女じゃん!
entries.translation_en: she's actually a pretty fine woman!

entries.text_jp: アヤセのダンナ達倹裲に

entries.translation_en: as one of Ayase's husband candidates?

entries.text_jp: 鳥隼鳥のように鼬くのよ!
entries.translation_en: you gotta work like an eager beaver!

entries.text_jp: もっとこき払っちゃうかんね!!
entries.translation_en: I'm gonna work you even harder!!

entries.text_jp: こんだけ歩き日ってるんだからぁ少しはダイエットになったかな?
entries.translation_en: Since I've been walking around this much, did I lose a little weight, I wonder?

entries.text_jp: ダメな毋覬だわあの子が苦しんでいる時は
entries.translation_en: I'm such a useless mother... When my child is suffering,

entries.text_jp: 何もしてあげられない…
entries.translation_en: I can't do a single thing for her...
Just how many of me are there?
Maki... In such a lonely place,

entries.text_jp: 一人でいるんですのね…
entries.translation_en: You are all by yourself, aren't you...?
I can't bear to watch this~
The 'Mirror Shard' was fitted into place.

entries.text_jp: ｜赤いコンパクト』になっている
悃希:ふぇぇぇぇぇぇぇぇん!!ママァ!!

entries.translation_en: Mark: Did you calm down a bit?
